name: Marcus
desc:
Marcus is inarguably the _coolest_ Stonespark, if not the **coolest** NPC (apart from [The Meat Lord](entity:the_meat_lord)), in this vast game of _Deepwoken_. He is of a _modest_ and _small_ size, unlike his **braggart Rock Golem** cousins, and _calm_ and _collected_ compared to his **belligerent Stonespark** siblings, who prefer to attack you on sight. He prefers relaxing over a nice warm beverage.

The only entity that could surpass Marcus' incomprehensible power would be [The Meat Lord](entity:the_meat_lord), as both have risen to levels **above** the powers of Drowned Gods.

Although Marcus does not give any rewards, XP, loot or even gameplay advice to the player, it's always great to talk to him as he is **undoubtedly**, **hands down**, the **most chill** NPC in **all** of Deepwoken.
additional_info: -   Prior to the July 14th, 2025 update, Marcus was the only Stonespark in the entire game, created before [Duke Ishamon Erisia](entity:duke_ishamon_erisia) decided to step up his security.
